body:
Curated 7 FatBaby observations into EMILY/BACKLOG.md INTAKE QUEUE.

Items:
- Founder real-time: many press releases arrive daily with (EXCHANGE:TICKER)-format mentions in the body text -- likely why not all tickered press releases are surfacing, ticker extraction/linking may not be catching this body-text format (2026-08-13T22:14:37Z)
- Founder real-time: ticker display standard is parenthetical exchange-prefixed, e.g. (NYSE:F) -- applies to the press-releases/ticker-linking work above (2026-08-13T22:14:31Z)
- Founder real-time: expects to see all tickered press releases on the press releases page (may be same root cause as the not-updating report above) (2026-08-13T22:14:22Z)
- Founder real-time: newssite press releases page is not updating (2026-08-13T22:14:22Z)
- Founder real-time: FatBaby newssite republishing the same governance story for BAC/BEN/BA/AMZN/F over and over -- likely duplicate-detection bug (2026-08-13T22:14:22Z)
- Founder real-time: add a startup ceremony that calls gpt2 with a test prompt once it's confirmed stable/healthy, and always logs the response as an Apple (recurring on every startup, not a one-off smoke test) (2026-08-13T22:11:08Z)
- Founder real-time: any future updates to the startup/reboot process (systemd units, runbook changes) should be queued through the same emily observe -> backlog curate pipeline, not done ad hoc (2026-08-13T22:09:24Z)
